title: Magic Patio

services.name: Private Events
services.desc: The Magic Patio is San Francisco's most exclusive private magic venue: a contemporary speakeasy theater featuring world-class magic, illusion, and mentalism by our resident magician Andrew Evans. From a nondescript doorway on Mission Street, your guests are transported into a warm, intimate theater full of magical possibilities - unlike anywhere else in the city. The Magic Patio is the perfect venue for corporate team outings, company holiday parties, client entertainment evenings, and private celebrations - for groups between 40-55 guests. Our approach is fully customizable: we build each event around your group, your milestone, and your vision. And planning is entirely stress-free. No
